title: Today in one sentence
text: Chip and space stocks bounced hard today (Vertiv rose 4.2% and Rocket Lab 5.4%), while Intuitive Surgical, Alphabet and GE Aerospace slipped, and tonight Meta reports its quarterly results after the close.

title: Meta reports tonight
text: Meta is scheduled to share its third quarter results after the market closed on Wednesday, October 21, with a call at 4:30 p.m. Eastern, according to earnings calendars. It closed at $697.52. Tomorrow morning the price may jump or drop depending on how the numbers compare with what analysts expected.

title: Lockheed Martin reports Thursday
text: Lockheed Martin will release its third quarter results before the market opens on Thursday, October 22. The stock closed at $551.51, just under the $554 low end of analyst price targets. A price target is a guess by professional analysts about where a stock could be in a year.

title: Chips led the bounce
text: AMD gained 3.4% to $552.72, Nvidia gained 2.5% to $221.97 and Taiwan Semiconductor gained 1.6%. After a rough stretch for AI stocks, buyers came back today. Chip stocks can swing a lot in both directions, so one good day does not tell us where they go next.

title: Health stocks were mixed
text: On Nasdaq, health care companies were the best sector on average, up 1.3%. But Eli Lilly fell 1.0% and Intuitive Surgical fell 2.3%. A sector average hides what each company did, which is one reason people look at companies one by one.

title: Lesson 17: Bull markets and bear markets
text: A bull market is a long stretch when prices mostly go up. A bear market is when they fall a lot, often 20% or more from a recent high. The names come from how the animals attack: a bull thrusts its horns up, a bear swipes down. In this board, the bear, base and bull numbers are three imagined futures, not predictions. Bear means a rough path, base means steady growth, and bull means a great path. Markets have always gone through both kinds of stretches, which is why patience matters. This is for learning, not advice to buy or sell anything.

title: Data coverage
text: Prices, 52 week ranges and sector changes come from FMP at today's close. Analyst targets and ratios are available only for some companies (NVDA, TSM, AMD, GOOGL, AMZN, MSFT, META, GE and LMT).
